subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about buying to the completed booking. With the summer travel window now peaking and CPIs spiking with demand, the input cost matters: Adjust puts travel eCPI in a $0.77 to $0.97 band, so a thin install number can hide an expensive cost per actual booking. The way Hopper and Airbnb push paid spend into the live booking window is the same logic we run, with a holdout so the bookings show as incremental to your organic demand. Worth comparing against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: summer booking-window CPI spike (Adjust eCPI band, sourced) + incrementality
register_notes: Stage 2 EN travel_and_booking: acknowledges second follow-up and references prior email; fresh angle = timely summer booking-window CPI spike + sourced travel eCPI band $0.77-$0.97 (Adjust, web-verified); reuses only parent-named peers (Hopper, Airbnb); MobUpps holdout/incrementality reference with no figure; 1 question mark; native US English; no sign-off; no X-not-Y.
